profile.visual_desc: Quadrupedal mechanical walker. Features a cylindrical green metal chassis with a large central lens, draped in dark blue fabric over four segmented legs.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Mechanical profile with a flat metal faceplate and a single glowing green optic sensor, wrapped in dark blue cloth.
profile.weapon_desc: Integrated high-output energy emitter located in the central head lens.
profile.step1_ready: Stationary stance facing down-right. The mechanical legs are braced with the central lens inactive.
profile.step2_windup: The ocular lens charges, glowing with increasing intensity from soft yellow to bright white.
profile.step3_impact: Discharges a wide, conical yellow energy beam from the lens toward the bottom-right target area.
profile.step4_finish: The energy trail thins and dissipates as the turret returns to its dormant cooling state.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy beam must align perfectly with the lens aperture, projecting at a 45-degree downward angle to the right.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains mechanical consistency. Charging and firing frames align with reference. VFX trajectory is correct.
